notes: Vela-1.0-Encoder-307M-Embedding sentence embedder (litert-community/Vela-1.0-Encoder-307M-Embedding-LiteRT, Hub revision f92189a9b751b3c5c927f3114419aa6c408012d3, published 2026-10-18): vllm-sr/Vela-1.0-Encoder-307M-Embedding (revision 290318fd, Apache-2.0) = a 22-layer ModernBERT encoder (768-d, 12 heads, GeGLU, the Gemma 256k tokenizer, alternating global / sliding-window(+-64) attention, YaRN RoPE) with mean pooling + L2 normalization in the graph; one static window per file (L64 / 128 / 256 / 512; a text runs in the smallest window that holds it). Two shipped forms per window, both float16 weights with float32 activations: the one-file form (input_ids; fp16 FULLY_CONNECTED weights + the fp16 token table in the graph) and the host-table form (inputs_embeds; the host reads tok_embeddings_fp16.bin, the checkpoint's float16 rows). Every shipped graph computes the LayerNorms of layers 12-21 and the final norm on x*2^-6 (eps*2^-12; layers 9-11 on x*2^-2) so float16 storage paths stay finite (bit-identical in fp32), and pools arithmetically ((h*m).sum / max(m.sum, eps), x*rsqrt(max(sum x^2, eps^2))) because the GPU delegate refuses the broadcast SELECT_V2 of torch.where. artifact_sha256 = the Hub LFS sha256 = the staged file (every LFS file MATCH). Reference for parity = the publisher's own stack (sentence-transformers 5.1.2 + transformers 4.57.6, CPU fp32, SDPA math), which reproduces the card's STS-B v2 Spearman (0.811867 vs 0.811864); check set = PAWS-X test en / es / ja / zh + STS-B v2 test + concatenated long texts (4,184 texts by dataset id + revision + row index; the phones run the subset that fits each window). Bar per row: cosine >= 0.999 on every text, top-1 retrieval agreement 100 % on non-near-tie queries, pair Spearman >= 0.999, the mask live, every output finite. Window L=512, host fp16 token table (inputs_embeds): the GPU (FP32 arithmetic) and NPU form: the host looks the token rows up in tok_embeddings_fp16.bin and feeds inputs_embeds; 140 device rows per check run at this window; the ship form at this window is the S26 HTP on the host-table file, GPU FP32 and CPU are the parity-passing fallbacks.
